brand.tagline_zh: 澳門專業攝影 · 證件照 · 形象照 · 家庭紀錄
brand.tagline_en: Professional Photography in Macau · ID Photos · Portrait · Family
brand.address: 澳門田畔街 9 號地下
brand.address_en: 9 Tap Seac St, Ground Floor, Macau

services.desc_zh: 白底證件照、合照規格，即拍即取。適合 visa、身份證、求職履歷表使用。
services.desc_en: White-background ID photos to spec, shot and printed on the spot. Ideal for visa, ID and résumé use.

services.desc_zh: 專業棚拍形象照，含妝髮。適合專業個人品牌、求職履歷、社交平台個人檔。
services.desc_en: Professional studio portrait, makeup and hair included. Great for personal branding, résumé and social profiles.

services.desc_zh: 家庭、寵物、孕婦、畢業等主題拍攝。1 小時專屬時段，可拍多組不同造型。
services.desc_en: Family, pet, maternity and graduation sessions. A dedicated 1-hour slot for multiple looks.

services.desc_zh: 婚禮、機構活動、演出等全場攝影。歡迎機構與團體查詢專屬方案。
services.desc_en: Full-event coverage for weddings, corporate functions and performances. Institutional packages welcome.

booking_hours.off_hours_message_zh: 營業時間以外的預約需求，可直接 inbox 我們，我們會盡快回覆確認。
booking_hours.off_hours_message_en: For requests outside opening hours, inbox us directly and we will reply to confirm.

reviews.text_zh: 證件照 15 分鐘搞掂，唔使特登再約，效率超高。相片出嚟好自然，唔係嗰種死板證件相。
reviews.text_en: ID photos done in 15 minutes without needing another appointment. Super efficient, and the results looked natural — not the usual stiff ID photo.

reviews.text_zh: 形象照成個過程好舒服，Chan 好有耐性教點樣擺pose。影完出嚟嘅相好有個人樣，唔係千篇一律。
reviews.text_en: The portrait session felt very relaxed — Chan was patient in explaining poses. The results looked like me, not like a template.

reviews.text_zh: 連我隻貓一齊影，Chan 好有耐性，等貓慢慢習慣鏡頭。最後出嚟張全家福掛咗喺客厅，成屋人都問邊度影。
reviews.text_en: Chan was patient enough to let our cat warm up to the camera. The family portrait is now framed in our living room and everyone asked where we took it.

reviews.text_zh: 成個活動交咗畀 Chan 拍，佢自己識捉moment，唔使我哋指。交相速度快，溝通清晰。
reviews.text_en: We left the whole event coverage to Chan and he captured the moments without us having to direct him. Fast delivery and clear communication.
